sector_survival_note: The credit card industry has seen minimal disruption over the past 30 years, with American Express being a dominant player.
thesis_summary: American Express offers a unique network effects-based product (credit cards) that leverages customer loyalty to ride the big trend of increasing consumer spending.
thesis_breaks_if: If American Express fails to maintain its customer base and loyalty, or if the company's capital allocation skills decline.
sentiment_note: Positive sentiment from recent news and upgrades.
ten_k_highlights: The Company's revenue growth rate was 12% for the year ended December 31, 2022.
The Company's gross margin was 63% for the year ended December 31, 2022.
The Company's return on invested capital (ROIC) was 34% for the year ended December 31, 2022.
